description: Receive email, with attachments, at a Project's own address.

serviceForm.label: Receiving domain
serviceForm.help: The Mailgun domain whose catch-all Route forwards every recipient to this service's webhook URL.

serviceForm.label: Webhook signing key
serviceForm.help: The Mailgun account's HTTP webhook signing key.

serviceForm.label: Largest attachment (MB)
serviceForm.help: Larger attachments are left out of the stored email and listed under omittedAttachments.

email.received.title: Email received
email.received.description: An email arrived at the Project's address; its data is described in the Service skill.
